# Current HF Audit

## Definitions
- `HF1`: charge timestamp from record start to first `Voltage_measured >= 4.2 V` (s); uses charge voltage/time.
- `HF2`: timestamp from that 4.2-V point to first subsequent `abs(Current_measured) <= 0.02 A` (s); uses charge current/voltage/time.
- `HF3`: charge timestamp difference between first `Voltage_measured >= 3.8 V` and first `>= 4.0 V` (s); uses charge voltage/time.

## Provenance risk
The legacy extractor applies centered rolling Hampel smoothing and bidirectional interpolation to the full battery sequence. Therefore F0 values can use future rows and are `LEGACY_REFERENCE_NOT_STRICTLY_CAUSAL`; no new feature in this audit uses that preprocessing.

## Raw-feature boundary
F1 scans only enough initial raw cycles to emit train+validation rows (B0007=67; B0018=51). It uses no future cycle, total lifetime or capacity field as an input; capacity is supervised target only. Features are available after the associated current discharge completes.

## HF completeness, exceptions and semantic limits

All three legacy HFs are in seconds and use charge `Voltage_measured`,
`Current_measured` (HF2 only) and `Time`. HF1 requires the current charge record
to reach 4.2 V; HF2 additionally requires a subsequent ≤0.02-A cutoff after that
point; HF3 requires 3.8-V and 4.0-V upward crossings. A charge cycle missing any
required event is skipped by the extractor. The feature formula itself needs the
completed current charge segment, not a future cycle. However, its subsequent
full-series centered smoothing/interpolation violates a strict causal boundary.

Within the training prefix, old HFs are not uniformly collinear: B0007 HF2/HF3
correlation is -0.591 and other absolute pairwise correlations are ≤0.288. Their
main limitation is therefore not simple duplicate columns. Their SOH associations
are battery-specific: e.g., HF1 Pearson is 0.500 in B0007 but 0.960 in B0018,
whereas HF2 is 0.653 in B0007 but 0.068 in B0018. The detailed variance,
missingness, pairwise correlations and early/late/validation stability values are
recorded in `output/feature_adequacy_reassessment_v1/feature_quality_metrics.csv`
and `feature_stability_metrics.csv`; they are descriptive only and did not select
features after validation.
